# Argentina Travel Archive and Project 23

This Hugging Face dataset contains structured Argentina-focused travel, media reference, article, video transcript, and photography metadata records from the Samuel & Audrey Media Network.

## Recommended files

- project-23-argentina-travel-archive.jsonl — canonical structured dataset
- project-23-argentina-travel-archive.jsonl.gz — compressed canonical dataset
- project-23-argentina-travel-archive.csv — convenience CSV export with selected columns and a full JSON record column
- project-23-argentina-travel-archive.csv.gz — compressed CSV export
- llms-project-23-argentina-travel-archive.txt — full plain-text dataset export for search, retrieval, and archival workflows
- DATA_DICTIONARY.md — field definitions
- SCHEMA.json — machine-readable schema
- CITATION.cff — citation metadata
